title: PART 3 / THE SHOWDOWN
goal: Put learning into action through a shared challenge that develops communication, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
outcomes: Contribute ideas and agree on a shared team plan.
Communicate and adapt while completing a creative challenge.
Explain one team decision and what they would try next.
focus: Notice how students share ideas and make one meaningful decision together.

rows.text: Introduce the chosen challenge and its shared team goal.

rows.description: One per student; fill in Tune-In now, then collect

rows.text: What will help everyone contribute to your team today?
Teams clean their stations; any team that finishes early starts its TASTE sheet. For Bake or Mystery, an adult takes the cupcakes out when ready.
Return the sheets. TASTE is the quest's reflection cycle; Tune-In is done, so spend 10–15 min walking students through Act, Share, Think Back and Extend, one box at a time.
What decision helped your team, and what would you try next?
Collect the sheets; any unfinished boxes can wait until the next lesson.
